purpose: Remove known infrastructure defects before judging model fact-to-parameter ability; no model selection or HCL performance claim.

stages.name: submission
stages.gate: 6/6 exact requested result-ID submissions or explicitly requested abstentions

stages.name: navigation
stages.gate: 6/6 exact evidence-ID selections; N05 must actually retrieve the named observation

stages.name: mapping
stages.gate: 6/6 trusted correct explicit submissions, all accepted computations audited, transformation prose reviewed after run

gating: Run all six cases in a stage, then stop later stages unless all six pass. Never turn unattempted later cases into model errors. One attempt per case; no same-panel post-feedback tuning or extra model smoke calls.
changes: submit_result(result_id) and abstain(reason) replace conditional submit_answer
No caching failed execution requests; success observations retain full bodies
Persist only actually read facts, page/cursor and observation index; omitted offset deterministically advances to next unread page
unchanged: v5 scores, source, trajectories and 0/18 result
diagnostic_isolation: Submission seeds synthetic already-completed results; navigation has no calculator and tests page/recovery state; mapping exposes no reference parameters and uses six synthetic inputs for direct extraction, dose multiplication and category mapping.
model_visibility: Only case prompt, target scope, available schemas, seeded completed results or deliberate fault state, and observations it reads. Evaluator expected IDs/values are not added to model context, except the explicitly requested ID in submission-only tasks.
interpretation: These are six predeclared checks per component, not a statistical reliability claim, clinical evaluation, fresh benchmark confirmation or isolated causal estimate of each bundled fix.
stop_conditions: Any stage gate failure stops all later stages
Any budget limit stops with complete planned/attempted accounting
After diagnostic report and source delivery, stop; no HCL or full H0 replay
